# Student Learning Management System - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import courses, enrollments, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Student Learning Management System API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a student learning management system with students, instructors, courses, ...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(courses.router, prefix="/api/courses", tags=["Course Management"])
app.include_router(enrollments.router, prefix="/api/enrollments", tags=["Enrollment Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Student Learning Management System", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to Student Learning Management System API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Student Learning Management System
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Course(Base):
    __tablename__ = "courses"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    code = Column(String(50), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    instructor_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    credits = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Enrollment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "enrollments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    course_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    enrolled_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)

class Assignment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "assignments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    course_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    due_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    max_points = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Submission(Base):
    __tablename__ = "submissions"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    assignment_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    student_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    content = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    grade = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    submitted_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

# Automated Integration Tests for Student Learning Management System
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_courses():
    res = client.get("/api/courses/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_course():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Course", "name": "Automated Test Course", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/courses/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Course" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Course"

def test_enroll_course():
    res = client.post("/api/courses/1/enroll")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "enrolled"

files.README.md:
# Student Learning Management System

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Student Learning Management System
- **Description**: Academic learning platform with course enrollments, assignment submissions, and grading workflow.
- **Primary Entity**: `Course`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Course`, `Enrollment`, `Assignment`, `Submission`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph User Access
    STUDENT["Student Web Portal"]
    FACULTY["Instructor Dashboard"]
  end

  subgraph API & Routing Tier
    ALB["Cloud Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["RBAC Guard (Student / Instructor)"]
    API["Student Learning Management System FastAPI Service"]
  end

  subgraph Academic Engines
    COURSE_MGR["Course & Enrollment Manager"]
    ASSIGN_MGR["Assignment & Deadline Tracker"]
    GRADE_ENGINE["Grading & Assessment Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Courses, Enrollments, Submissions)")]
    DOCS[("S3 Course Material & Files")]
  end

  STUDENT --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  FACULTY --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> COURSE_MGR
  API --> ASSIGN_MGR
  API --> GRADE_ENGINE
  COURSE_MGR --> PG
  ASSIGN_MGR --> PG
  GRADE_ENGINE --> PG
  COURSE_MGR --> DOCS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/student-learning-management-system`
